subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems involving transformations, Pythagorean theorem, or volume, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student solves a realistic design or navigation scenario requiring transformation, distance, or volume calculation
exercise.pictorial: Student draws and labels a diagram representing the problem before solving
exercise.abstract: Student solves a multi-step geometry word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot identify which geometric tool (transformation, Pythagorean theorem, or volume formula) the problem calls for

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
